description: Source code for Mattermost plugin management commands using Cobra CLI framework, including add, install-url, delete, enable, disable, and list commands.

classes.name: cobra.Command
classes.description: Defines CLI commands for plugin management (add, install-url, delete, enable, disable, list).

methods.name: pluginAddCmdF
methods.description: Handles adding plugins by uploading files, with optional force overwrite.

methods.name: pluginInstallURLCmdF
methods.description: Handles installing plugins from URLs, with optional force overwrite.

methods.name: pluginListCmdF
methods.description: Handles listing all plugins, showing active and inactive.
